pain: Agent coding overload makes it hard to measure CI wait, execution and comparable runner speed without fabricated telemetry.
done_when: Strict GitHub Job Attempt input rejects invalid source IDs, evidence URLs, timestamps and untrusted shapes; source-created to started duration is explicitly a proxy, not verified runnable queue time.
Separate execution and end-to-end durations preserve Unknown on missing, reversed or future-inconsistent timestamps and never invent source facts.
Comparable environment and cache-mode grouping with deterministic p50/p95 thresholds refuses to rank insufficient or stale samples.
Reruns, Duplicate/conflicting evidence, unsuccessful jobs and caller-owned sample immutability are covered by synthetic tests.
The scheduling intent, ADR and spec preserve GitHub Authority and prohibit any job dispatch, runner activation, paid overflow, credential action or production deploy.
